items.q: How much does junk removal cost?
items.a: You pay for how much of the truck your junk fills, from $149 for a 1/8 truck or one item to $649 for a full truck, loading, hauling and drop-off included. Demo is priced per job. See the pricing page.

items.q: What if I'm not sure how much I have?
items.a: Pick "Not sure" when you book and add a few photos. We'll price it from those and confirm before we come.

items.q: Can the price change when you get here?
items.a: Only if the job is different from what we agreed, like extra items or heavy material we didn't know about. If it does, we tell you before we load anything.

items.q: When and how do I pay?
items.a: When the job's done, before we drive off. Card or cash.
Furniture, appliances, mattresses, household junk, garage and basement clutter, yard waste and demo debris. The full list is on our services page.
Paint, oil and chemicals, propane tanks, asbestos, medical waste and car batteries. Many towns run a household hazardous waste day for paint and chemicals. Not sure about something? Ask us.
Yes, where we can. Tell us what's still good when you book and we'll take it to a local charity or reuse store instead of the dump. Need a receipt? Say so and we'll ask for one.

items.q: What kind of demo do you do?
items.a: Sheds, decks and porches, fences, playsets, and kitchen and bathroom tear-outs. Demo can need a town permit, and older buildings can hide asbestos, so check with your building department first.
Pick a day and your load online, add photos if you can, and send it. Shawn looks it over and gets back to you to confirm the time and the price.
Yes. Call (603) 555-0142, Mon to Sat, 7am to 7pm, and we'll book it with you on the phone.
Check the calendar for the next open days. If you need it sooner, call us and we'll see what we can do.

items.q: Do you come to my town?
items.a: Probably. See the full list on our service area page, and if yours isn't there, give us a call.
Call us as soon as you know and we'll work it out with you.

items.q: Do I need to carry anything outside?
items.a: No. We carry it out from wherever it is, including basements and upstairs rooms.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: It helps to have someone there at the start to show us what goes and what stays. If you can't be there, tell Shawn when he confirms and you can work it out.
Clear a path to the junk, move the car and check drawers and boxes for anything you want to keep. If something's staying, put a note on it.

items.q: How long does a job take?
items.a: It depends on how much there is and how far it has to go. One item can be minutes, and a full basement can take a few hours.
